scope.credentialScoping: Dedicated runtime environment variables cover Ask Civica, Pulse classifier/summary, bill summary, and reconciliation. Pulse provider selection is limited to a checked provider/model allowlist.
scope.localCostControls: Every paid path has checked input/output, call, retry, and unavailable-state ceilings. Pulse classify is capped at 50 clusters per execution; bill summaries at 25 calls of 20 rows; Stats SA at four PDF calls.
scope.versioning: Ask Civica audit events, bill summary cache keys, Stats SA provenance payloads, and existing Pulse classification configuration/stage envelopes carry deterministic model/provider version identity.
scope.secretSafety: Model paths log fixed outcome labels rather than provider exception objects, request content, raw responses, or credentials.
scope.billingFallback: There is no generic key or alternate provider/model fallback. The legacy Pulse v1 export returns without a model call; dynamic reasoning-token expansion is disabled.
